title: Hoodlum Soldier Ep 8: Fix What I Broke

scenes.say: Later that week, a letter from his sister.
scenes.visual: a soldier reading a letter on a bunk in a desert barracks, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: I made honor roll! I hope you come home soon. Mommy says you're a hero.
scenes.visual: a child's handwritten letter with a gold star sticker, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Ali smiles and closes his eyes.
scenes.visual: a soldier leaning back against a wall, eyes closed, letter on his chest, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: I was fighting more for her now than myself.
scenes.visual: the letter tucked into a helmet band, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: On the base wall at night, Ali and Q sit with their legs over the ledge.
scenes.visual: two soldiers sitting on top of a wall at night, legs dangling, seen from behind, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Q: I enlisted to pay off my grandma's house. Thought I'd do four and bounce.
scenes.visual: lights of a desert base below a starry sky, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Ali: I ran from a jail cell. Q: And now?
scenes.visual: two silhouettes on a wall against the night sky, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Now I just wanna live long enough to fix what I broke.
scenes.visual: dawn breaking over the desert from a base wall, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Follow for Episode Nine. Turn negative into positive.
scenes.visual: a sunrise over sand and wire, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

caption: HOODLUM SOLDIER, Episode 8 of 25: Fix What I Broke. From the screenplay by Elvin Torres Sr. New episode every 48 hours.
